thread:
sam: Heads-up — CloudNine asked for a short performance bench next Mon. They want sustained 350 qps for text-generation (approx 250 tokens avg). Can we confirm run plan and pricing guidance?
priya: I can own the test profile and prompt set. Two questions: target p95 <= 200ms or p95 <= 400ms? And do they care about tail latency >99?
sam: Sales note: they want p95 <= 300ms as a gating SLA, p99 is negotiable but flag if wildly high. Also they asked if Dedicated pool needed for consistent numbers.
eli: For reproducible numbers let's use a dedicated small pool (2xA10G equiv) and pin model to gpt-open-16k-v1-quant. Plan: 30m warmup, 60m steady at 350 qps, then a 10m burst to 600 qps to validate backpressure.
priya: Test payload: mix of short (50 tokens) 60%, medium (200 tokens) 30%, long (500 tokens) 10%. I'll upload a sanitized prompt set.
jamie: Ops: make sure KV cache is enabled for repeated prefixes. Without prefix caching our tail will be worse. Also set batching window to 6ms and max batch size 64 for this model.
eli: Example load runner (k6) snippet I'll run:
```
const options = { vus: 200, duration: '70m', rps: 350 }
// simplified, will use script that cycles payload sizes and records latency buckets
```
eli: We'll collect token-level cost estimates via per-request token counts and confirm cost per hour.
alex-sales: Pricing ask from customer: what is expected hourly burn for that Dedicated configuration and how much of a delta to hosted (on-demand)? Put numbers we can quote in call.
priya: Rough calc: at 350 qps * avg 250 tokens = 87.5k tokens/sec -> 315M tokens/hr. With our hosted rate that's X per 1M tokens, ballpark 315 * rate. I'll compute exact and send.
jamie: Also note encryption ask: CloudNine requires KMS key for model cache and VPC-only egress. For Dedicated we can support customer-managed KMS but need SOC2 addendum signed. Security might be a blocker until legal signs it.
alex-sales: Noted — I'll start security questionnaire handoff. Priority: get bench numbers before legal drags. If run on our hosted verify whether we can replicate expected numbers; if not, recommend Dedicated.
priya: Action items: I (Priya) will prepare prompt set + k6 script by EOD Fri. Eli will provision a dedicated pool for Monday with KV cache and batching config. Jamie will validate kernel/quantization profile and share runtime flags. Alex will prepare pricing ranges and call script for customer.
eli: provisioning ticket created: ticket#INF-8732 — deploying pool in us-west-2, ETA Mon 06:30 PT. deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for 2026-03-23 06:25 PT to infra/us-west-2/dedicated-pools/infra-2.
sam: Great — Priya, please include expected token counts per request in the artifact so Alex can finalize pricing. If we hit p95 < 300ms on Dedicated we can offer a 90-day SLA trial.
priya: Will do. saving checklist here and will drop artifacts: prompt_set.csv, k6_script.js, expected_token_counts.csv. :thumbsup:
jamie: One more: capture GPU utilization and per-request KV hit-rate; those are key to explain cost regressions to customer.
alex-sales: I'll add legal and solutions eng to the next call invite. Thanks team, keeping this thread for run updates.
eli: I'll post run results (latency histograms, throughput chart, cost calc) in this thread after execution.
sam: Awesome, thanks everyone.
